command:
set -euo pipefail
LA="$HOME/local-agent"
EXPECTED="f1709acd7080ecba191d7a266f332977417f685f"
WT="/private/tmp/local-agent-chat-bridge-wake-only-v45"
BR="chat-bridge-wake-only-v45"
STAGING="v0.3.2-staging"
test "$(git -C "$LA" branch --show-current)" = main
test "$(git -C "$LA" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"
test "$(git -C "$LA" rev-parse origin/main)" = "$EXPECTED"
test -z "$(git -C "$LA" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)"
python3 - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib
p=pathlib.Path.home()/"local-agent/chat_bridge/manifest.json"
assert json.loads(p.read_text())["version"] == "0.3.2"
PY
if [ -d "$WT" ]; then git -C "$LA" worktree remove "$WT"; fi
if git -C "$LA" show-ref --verify --quiet "refs/heads/$BR"; then git -C "$LA" branch -d "$BR"; fi
for R in "$BR" "$STAGING"; do if git -C "$LA" ls-remote --exit-code --heads origin "$R" >/dev/null 2>&1; then git -C "$LA" push --quiet origin --delete "$R"; fi; done
if [ -d /private/tmp/local-agent-chat-bridge-wake-only-v44 ]; then git -C "$LA" worktree remove --force /private/tmp/local-agent-chat-bridge-wake-only-v44 || rm -rf /private/tmp/local-agent-chat-bridge-wake-only-v44; fi
echo "PRODUCTION_HEAD=$(git -C "$LA" rev-parse HEAD)"
echo "PRODUCTION_DIRTY=$(git -C "$LA" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
for R in "$BR" "$STAGING"; do if git -C "$LA" ls-remote --exit-code --heads origin "$R" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "REMOTE_BRANCH_PRESENT=$R"; exit 1; else echo "REMOTE_BRANCH_ABSENT=$R"; fi; done
echo CHAT_BRIDGE_CLEANUP=PASS
